many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def grav_right_rowcomp(g):
    # per row: group consecutive same-color runs; slide each run right until blocked by 2 or previous run (processed right-to-left)
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        # collect nonzero cells excluding 2, scan right to left
        cells=[j for j in range(W) if g[i][j]!=0 and g[i][j]!=2]
        out_row=[]
        for j in range(cells[-1],-1,-1):
            v=g[i][cells[j]]
            k=j
            while k+1<W and out_row and out_row[-1]==v and k==cells[j]: pass
            # place at rightmost free spot right of already-placed cells in this row, skipping 2s
            tgt=k+1
            while tgt<W and (out[i][tgt]==2 or out[i][tgt]!=0 and True):
                pass
            break
        out[i]=out_row
    return out
# simpler direct approach: per row, compress rightward preserving order, 2s stay
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for i in range(H):
        row=[x for x in g[i] if x!=0 and x!=2]
        rem=W-len(row)
        for j,x in enumerate(row): out[i][rem+j]=x
    return out
print(f(G['Demo pair 3 input'])==G['Demo pair 3 output'])
